verdict.rationale: Ente Auth lets users delete or edit individual codes and move codes to a Trash section, where they can be recovered or deleted permanently. Retention can also be limited to the device by using it without an account, since offline-mode codes are stored only on that device. However, the evidence does not document account deletion or how long server-side data is kept, so it covers only part of retention control. missing for 10: account/cloud-data deletion, documented server-side retention policy or periods, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: You can recover codes from here, in case of accidental deletions, or delete them permanently.
You can now trash codes that you don't need. These items will be moved to a separate section within the app, under the "Trash" header.
You can delete or edit a code by long pressing (or right clicking on desktop) on that item.
In offline mode, your codes are stored only on that device.
